g.text: Heights are metres above local grade. FAA DOF points (triangles) are surveyed
tops (1A: +-20 ft horizontal, +-3 ft vertical) of the highest element there -
often a stair / elevator tower, pole or helix, not the roof deck.
NAIP 2024 is not one moment: noon-like over the terminals and the North Field,
a morning frame over the Superbay; relief lean differs per frame (0.30-0.33
m/m east in the North Field, north-west at the Superbay).
